messages.subject: RE: Problems with 0.9.1
parts:
You'll need to load the scales packages as well.

library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
qplot(carat,price,data=diamonds,colour=color,alpha = I(0.01)) +scale_y_continuous(labels=dollar)

Best regards,

Thierry

On Thu, May 31, 2012 at 2:24 AM, Christian <chsc...@email.de> wrote:
> Hey ,
>
> I just firgure out the new examples from
> http://cloud.github.com/downloads/hadley/ggplot2/guide-col.pdf
> But havings some trouble?

Load the scales package before running this code chunk, because the
dollar_format() function resides there:

library('scales')

>  t1 <- qplot(carat,price,data=diamonds,colour=color,alpha = I(0.01)) +
> scale_y_continuous(labels=dollar)
> Fehler in structure(list(call = match.call(), aesthetics =
> aesthetics,  :
>  Objekt 'dollar' nicht gefunden
>

This yields the expected output AFAIR. (BTW, the guide is a colorbar,
not a legend :) It sounds as though you were missing the points in the
graphics region, but they displayed properly for me.

> ## only axes and legend displayed ###
> p1 <- ggplot(mtcars,aes(x=disp,y=mpg,colour=wt)) + geom_point() +
> scale_colour_gradient(low="blue",high="orange",guide="colorbar")

I'm running 0.9.1 on a 64-bit Win 7 system for this test.

Dennis
